label: Christian sermon and Bible commentary
explanation: Fires in long spans across Christian devotional prose — sermons and Bible-study retellings of scripture (Samaritan woman, Pentecost, David, Revelation) — landing mostly on frequent function words, so no single token predicts it. Strongest in dense biblical narrative and exposition, weaker on other religious mythology (Hindu, Norse) and marginal religious narrative, and essentially silent in secular text and at the very start of sequences.
